label: Illustrative example: recording a meeting from the phone, four minutes in, with what happens after you stop.
title: Record a meeting
subtitle: Talk as normal. When you stop, the assistant writes the minutes and drafts what follows.

items.label: Recording
items.note: Keep the phone near the table. Pause when you step out.

items.title: Minutes in the Assistant
items.body: Decisions, agreements and next steps, with who does what.

items.title: Drafts to check
items.body: The quotation, tasks and messages. Nothing is sent without your yes.
